339-574-677-1849.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-1849.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

333-2921-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2921-8207.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

512-4091-7287.easyPrerequisites: Transdimensional Bovine and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-4091-7287.description:
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Transdimensional Bovine, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

3967-4186-6854--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 5.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Dominion Saboteur each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3263-4050-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
3263-4050-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Mycosynth Lattice and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing that creature, adding one mana.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.

1409-6463-7824.description:
Activate Meticulous Artisan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Meticulous Artisan enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Meticulous Artisan.
Resolve the Meticulous Artisan trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

215-527-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

413-2961-3175.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1170-5078-6979-7356.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-5078-6979-7356.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten and Longshot trigger, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Longshot trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1453-4559-5231-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-4559-5231-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4365-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4311-4871-5220-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4311-4871-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1563-2557-3899-6965.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7154.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4002-4331-4993-6709.easyPrerequisites:
You control three or more lands that share a name.

4002-4331-4993-6709.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

198-1978-4324.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Workshop Elders.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
198-1978-4324.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.

Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4359-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
4359-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
4359-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

851-1887-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
851-1887-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

423-3609-3756-4011.notablePrerequisites:
Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
You are able to play a number of lands this turn equal to four minus the number of charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
423-3609-3756-4011.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Evolution Sage trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Repeat from step 1 until Magistrate's Scepter has four or more charge counters on it.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1074-3525-4549.notablePrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura attached to King Macar.
1074-3525-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping King Macar, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling a creature an opponent controls and creating a Gold artifact token.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2084-2990.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a commander.
2084-2990.description:
Cast Sakashima's Will by paying {3}{U}, causing you to gain control of a creature an opponent controls, then causing all creatures you control to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate the creature your opponent owns by paying {1}{U}, causing its owner to shuffle the creature into their library, and then mill their entire library.

2152-3681-5280.notablePrerequisites: Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Fate Unraveler.
2152-3681-5280.description:
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library and draw seven cards.
Fate Unraveler triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library, draw seven cards, and exile Echo of Eons.
Fate Unraveler triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1479-2783-3756.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2783-3756.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Nesting Dragon, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2615-3041-3432.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
You have at leat 21 life.
2615-3041-3432.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Star of Extinction for {5}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing 20 damage to all creatures and planeswalkers.
Coalhauler Swine triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.
